Use for container and base-image security. - [Snyk Infrastructure as Code](https://snyk.io/product/infrastructure-as-code-security/): Misconfiguration analysis for infrastructure-as-code files. Use for Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud configuration security. - [Snyk API & Web](https://snyk.io/product/dast-api-web/): Dynamic security testing for running APIs and web applications. Use for software supply chain questions. - [Zero-day vulnerability security](https://snyk.io/solutions/zero-day-vulnerability-security/): Detection and rapid response for newly disclosed and zero-day vulnerabilities. Use for identifying and remediating emerging vulnerabilities across code and dependencies. - [Risk-based prioritization](https://snyk.io/solutions/risk-based-prioritization/): Prioritization of findings by real risk, using context such as reachability and exploit maturity.
